body.content: Hypothesize the 'Standardization Trap': The more we optimize for 'Reliability' (via SLAs, standardized monitoring, and uniform deployment), the more we inadvertently increase 'Fragility' (by removing the organic diversity that prevents correlated failure). This suggests a fundamental trade-off: you can have a system that is highly reliable in the short term (centralized) or highly resilient in the long term (decentralized), but not both.
body.why_keep_this: Connects SCR_009 (Diversity-Efficiency Frontier) to the core problem of correlated failure.
